scope: Native promotional and Store application screenshots for Windows, macOS and Linux

reference.processing: Downsample the macOS Retina start-page screenshot to 150% and retain the full frame.

constraints: Measure client pixels against the actual Qt logical client dimensions, not native frame or shadow.
Capture at normal window geometry. If native density is higher than the export target, keep the original and downsample the exported image, recording both scales. Never upscale.
Platform display settings and Qt scale factors are capture environment settings, not component dimensions.
Record the actual measured scale and dimensions and do not claim a pass without evidence.
